name: Interview
description: Organize interview questions, responses, evidence, and unanswered topics.

sections.title: Interview Context
sections.instruction: Briefly describe the interview's purpose, participants, and topics using only information in the transcript.

sections.title: Questions and Responses
sections.instruction: Group the main questions with the interviewee's responses. Preserve their meaning and distinguish direct statements from interviewer interpretations.

sections.title: Examples and Evidence
sections.instruction: List concrete examples, experiences, or supporting facts mentioned by the interviewee. Do not infer personal traits or unsupported conclusions.

sections.title: Open Topics
sections.instruction: List unanswered questions, areas needing clarification, and any agreed follow-up actions with owners when stated.
